notes.title: [Development Update] New Cinematic Control System Coming Soon!
notes.content:
\[Development Update] New Cinematic Control System for Animations Coming Soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/39bef2210377cf94fbe20bc0cd9a653ebd586888.png"]

Hey everyone! 👋

We wanted to share a sneak peek at something we've been cooking up based on your feedback - a new multi-scene animation control system that we're implementing for more complex cinematic sequences!

How It Works: As you can see in the preview, this new system allows for seamless navigation through multi-camera angles and different character poses within the same animation sequence. The progression system works like this:

✅ Scenes 1-3: Viewed and unlocked (available for replay)

▶️ Scene 4: Currently viewing

🔓 Scene 5: Unlocked but not yet viewed (new content ready!)

🔒 Scene 6: Locked (requires progression)

This gives you more control over your viewing experience while maintaining the sense of discovery and progression that's core to the game.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/a7ee8b84fd294036d7b5bf79a354a4191ee23a50.png"]

🆕 NEW IN TODAY'S UPDATE - Animation Pacing Control! We've just introduced a new Pacing control feature to ensure you never miss animations again! You can now choose between:

Full (0s) - No delay

Quick (1.5s) - Default setting

Cinematic (3.5s) - Recommended for best experience!

Minimum (6s) - Maximum delay between animations

You can find this in the Settings menu under the Pacing section. While Quick is enabled by default, we recommend trying the Cinematic pacing for the intended experience. We've also increased the font size of all settings labels for better readability!

Quality Updates: In our commitment to delivering the best experience possible:

We've removed 4 animations (including some car and zoom sequences) that weren't meeting our quality standards

Currently reworking 5 animations to fix eye tracking inconsistencies and improve overall quality

These animation fixes will be patched in within the next few days to a week! 🔧

Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify these issues! 🙏

When Can You Expect This?

Pacing Control: Available NOW in today's update!

Animation fixes: Coming in the next few days to a week

New cinematic control system: Rolling out around Episode 2 or potentially a bit earlier if testing goes smoothly

What do you think about this new approach to cinematic sequences? Would you like more granular control over multi-scene animations? Let us know in the comments below!

Thanks for your continued support and patience as we polish these features!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - UI & Cinematic Improvements
notes.content:
Thanks to the valuable feedback from our community survey, we've implemented several important changes to improve your experience:
What's New:

Animation Pacing Controls - Added new "Pacing" settings in Preferences, giving you complete control over animation timing:

Standard (1.5s) - Default
Cinematic (3.5s) - For dramatic effect
Instant (no pause) - For speed runners
Director's Cut (10s) - The full cinematic experience


Improved UI Readability - Increased menu label font sizes from 16 to 22 for better visibility and accessibility
Day 1 Animation Fixes - Resolved multiple animation timing and transition issues in the opening chapter

Based on Your Feedback:
Your survey responses were eye-opening - 47.9% wanted MORE animations while 31.3% felt there were too many. Rather than pick a side, we've given everyone what they want:

Removed repetitive car animations that interrupted story flow
Polish pass on existing animations for smoother transitions
Full player control - YOU decide the pacing that works for you

Coming Soon:

Additional animation refinements
Further UI improvements
More accessibility options

The split in feedback showed us there's no one-size-fits-all approach. That's why we've focused on customization - letting you tailor the experience to your preferences.
Thank you for your continued support and honest feedback. Keep it coming!

notes.title: Dev update #11 - 🎮 Draft Build Sneak Peek – New UI, Dual Visual Modes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="B5avbRfwpWE;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone,

We wanted to share a quick update on what we’ve been cooking — and give you a first look at the new draft build of Sofia’s Dark Fantasies. We’re deep into development and pushing hard on something that’s both ambitious and beautiful.

Heads up: the video shows a work-in-progress build. There’s a lot more polish and improvements on the way, including hover-preview videos for short stories, smoother transitions, new sound layering, and additional UI refinements.
✨ A Whole New Game Experience
We’ve completely overhauled the game’s interface and design, introducing a sleek new look and feel — as you’ll see in the attached video. Menus are animated, responsive, and immersive, with short stories now living directly in the main menu for easier access and replayability.
🎨 3D vs AI-Polished Image Mode
We’re also introducing something brand new to the AVN space: a toggle that lets you switch between raw 3D renderings and our AI-polished cinematic style — on the fly. This gives you control over how you experience Sofia’s world, whether you prefer the realism of unfiltered renders or the fantasy richness of AI-enhanced visuals.
📖 Short Stories & Core Release
The Short Stories will live in their own section and release monthly

Each one features ~130 unique images and 20–30 animations

Think of them as Veil App experiments — bite-sized but intense

Meanwhile, the main storyline is progressing beautifully:

We’re working on the last scene of Day 4

The Day 1 script is fully finalized and locked in

We estimate 1–2 more months of polish and development

The steam release will contain 2 more days and a lot of more content, bare with us, it will be amazing!
🖼️ Coming in 4K
Yes — the full game will be released in native 4K resolution. Whether you’re playing fullscreen or on ultra-wide setups, it’s going to look incredible

Hello Steam Community,

We want to provide you with an important update regarding the release schedule of Episode 1 and Episode 2 Chapter 1 of our game. We've made the decision to delay the release to ensure that we meet the high standards we've set for our project. This delay allows us to incorporate significant improvements and ensure the gameplay experience is as immersive and polished as possible.

The decision to delay was not made lightly. We're implementing more detailed updates, extending scenes, and enhancing animations to enrich the narrative and visual experience. These enhancements take time, but we are confident they will offer a more satisfying and engaging game to our players.

For ongoing updates and a closer look at our development process, please consider visiting our Patreon
